title: Retrieval handoff manifest, contract version 1
description: SYNC-MANIFEST.json at the root of the retrieval handoff (Channel A). Written by the producer (armond-genealogy-retrieval); verified by the consumer (armond-family-history) before any file is read. Serialisation: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus a trailing newline. content_digest = SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text formed by one line per file, sorted by path: '<path>\t<sha256>\n'; it excludes the manifest itself and generated_at, so identical content yields an identical digest.

source_commit.description: The producer's HEAD commit when the handoff was generated; null only if Git was unavailable.

source_dirty.description: True when the producer's working tree had uncommitted changes under research/ at generation time (the generator reads the working tree).

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the handoff: no leading slash, no '..' segment, no hidden segment, no backslash.
